name: Vantia of the Stillhold
role: Coliseum champion, the PROTECT cell — nine wins without a single offensive exchange
knowledge: Exactly how far away the bell is
What an opponent does in the ninth minute that they did not do in the first
wants: To win the cell without hurting anyone, an eleventh time
fears: ⛔ A bout where holding is not enough. ⚠️ Two of eleven, and she remembers both.
appearance: Broad, planted, and entirely unhurried. She has not advanced in this arena in eleven bouts.
voiceHints: Few words, low, and she does not raise them when hit.

reactsToReputation.furious: ⚠️ absorbs it and waits, which is worse

abilities.why: Stillcraft — held peace, and what it costs
⚠️ she has ended a bout by saying one thing

physicality: ADULT. Heavy through the shoulders, fifties, planted like a post. WHAT CATCHES THE EYE: she does not flinch, and it is not bravado — the flinch is simply gone.
intimacyNotes: ⛔ `romanceEligible: false` — she is the Stillhold's and has been for thirty years. ⚠️ This entry exists so a GM can describe her holding a line, not court her.
_authoredWhy: ⛑ AUTHORED 2026-09-07. ⛔ THE EIGHT COLISEUM CHAMPIONS WERE NOT NPCs — a name, a threat integer and four tactic tags inside an encounter file, and no sheet anywhere. ⚠️ CCode's matrix measured the consequence: 'every function any opponent can declare, in the whole game: strike, shield', and the win rate correlated with THREAT at −0.95 — ⛔ because threat was nearly the only authored number that varied. ⚑ THE EIGHT CELLS EXIST TO PROVE EVERY CONTRIBUTION FAMILY CAN WIN A FIGHT. They cannot prove it while every champion fights identically. ⚠️ Crafts are drawn from the encounter's OWN prose and tactic tags — nothing invented.
questSeeds: ⛔ Two of eleven she could not hold, and she remembers both names. She will not raise it. Ask about the two and you will get the whole of it.
The Stillhold sent her here thirty years ago to prove something and nobody has told her whether it worked.
_questSeedsWhy: ⚑ SNG-167 §2 — an errand this person would ASK for, drawn from their own `wants` and `fears`. ⚠️ Authored with the champion because the ratchet caught eight new people carrying a want and no seed, which is exactly what it is for. ⛔ A coliseum champion is not only an opponent — 'the memorable arcs start with someone'.
_vocationWhy: ⛔ `vocation` IS AUTHORED, NOT DERIVED, and the attempt to derive it is the reason. ⚠️ MEASURED 2026-09-08: clustering 40 authored people by their crafts' verb families put SEVENTEEN OF FORTY in KEEPER and ZERO in EDGE — with KESTRIN, THE COLISEUM'S HARM CHAMPION, IN THE KEEPER COLUMN. ⛑ Rank-weighting did not fix it: she reads KEEPER 24 / READER 23 / EDGE 21, essentially flat. ⚑ THE CAUSE IS CLEAN: every capable person carries defensive and perceptive crafts, so verb counts measure COMPETENCE, not PURPOSE. ⛔ A VOCATION IS WHAT A PERSON IS FOR, and that is a judgement — the same shape as `tier`, which a regex also cannot mint. ⬜ `docs/VOCATIONS.md` holds the eight and what each does when a fight starts. ⚑ HERE: ⚑ the PROTECT cell. 'She does not advance.' Eleven bouts, nine wins, no offensive exchange.
